description: This file contains service implementations for managing manufacturing production runs in the OFBiz framework. It includes functions to create, update, cancel, and change the status of production runs and their associated tasks, handling related entities such as work efforts, routing, components, costs, and party assignments.

classes.name: ProductionRunServices
classes.description: Contains service methods to manage production runs and their associated tasks in manufacturing processes.

methods.name: cancelProductionRun
methods.description: Cancels an existing production run if it is in a cancellable state, ensuring no dependent production runs are active, and updates related entities to reflect cancellation.

methods.name: createProductionRun
methods.description: Creates a new production run along with routing, tasks, components, and associated entities based on product routing and BOM data.

methods.name: updateProductionRun
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing production run, such as quantity or start date, and recalculates associated data if necessary.

methods.name: changeProductionRunStatus
methods.description: Handles the transition of production run status through various states like scheduled, printed, running, completed, and closed, updating related tasks accordingly.

methods.name: changeProductionRunTaskStatus
methods.description: Changes the status of individual production run tasks, managing task dependencies, issuing components, completing tasks, and updating the overall production run status.

methods.name: getWorkEffortCosts
methods.description: Retrieves cost components for a given work effort, sums costs, and returns total costs and costs excluding materials.

methods.name: getProductionRunCost
methods.description: Calculates the total cost of a production run by summing the header and task-related costs.

methods.name: createProductionRunTaskCosts
methods.description: Creates cost components for a production run task, either via predefined calculations or custom methods, and optionally accounts for fixed asset costs.

methods.name: checkUpdatePrunRoutingTask
methods.description: Validates and updates routing task details such as start date and priority, recalculating scheduled data as needed.

methods.name: addProductionRunComponent
methods.description: Adds a component to a production run, validating status and creating associated work effort standards.

methods.name: updateProductionRunComponent
methods.description: Updates a production run component, adjusting quantities and related details.

methods.name: addProductionRunRoutingTask
methods.description: Creates a new routing task within a production run, calculating estimated completion, copying party assignments, and creating related work efforts.

methods.name: productionRunProduce
methods.description: Completes production of a specified quantity, creating inventory items, updating quantities on work effort, and managing lots.

methods.name: productionRunTaskProduce
methods.description: Produces inventory for a specific production run task, creating inventory items and updating costs and quantities.

methods.name: productionRunDeclareAndProduce
methods.description: Declares completion and produces inventory for the entire production run, verifying quantities and handling lots.

methods.name: getProductionRunTotResQty
methods.description: Returns the total quantity reserved by production runs for a given productId up to a specific start date.

methods.name: checkDecomposeInventoryItem
methods.description: Checks if an inventory item can be decomposed and initiates decomposition if applicable.

methods.name: decomposeInventoryItem
methods.description: Performs decomposition of an inventory item into components, creating work efforts and returning components to inventory with appropriate costs.

methods.name: setEstimatedDeliveryDates
methods.description: Calculates and sets estimated delivery dates for production orders, purchase orders, and backorders based on current data and schedules.
